title: Next by Nature's debut single "That's Me" is a smooth and sultry track
htmlContent:
Next by Nature's debut single "That's Me" is a smooth and sultry track that showcases the talents of Vin Rock and KayGee of Naughty by Nature and the R&B trio NEXT.

The single, which is the first taste from a forthcoming full-length album, is a collaborative effort that highlights the long-standing relationship between the artists. DJ KayGee, who produced NEXT's debut album, Rated Next, and Welcome II Nextasy, notes that the joint project was a way to ignite the family to come together. RL from NEXT adds that the collaboration feels like a coronation, as he and his groupmates work alongside their idols. "That's Me" is a tantalizing lead single that is sure to whet fans' appetites for the full album, and the artists hope that the project will serve as a reminder of the incredible catalog of music that each member of the family has to offer.
